caption:
Overnight, a team of AI agents assembled to build an AWS platform, one job each.

Between 02:00 and 06:45 UTC on 23 November: a programme memo, then twenty agents named in a behaviour policy, each allowed to change only its own files. An ontologist, a billing accountant, a journalist, a video maker, even an agent that draws the team. Their shared build is live: Try the twin, a synthetic AWS inside your browser at aws.platform.sovereignweb.site. The journalist corrected its own figure. Thirteen agents moved to a second account mid-shift; more are moving now.

The presenter is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.
